title: AMD local AI command centre benchmark result
description: Stable contract for benchmark results. Measurement fields stay null until a real, reproducible run populates them; fabricated numbers are forbidden (ADR-005).

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds; null until measured.

memory_peak_mb.description: Peak memory during the run in MiB; null until measured.

runtime.description: Runtime adapter id and version/tag that produced the numbers.

model.description: Catalogue model id that produced the numbers.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 time of the run.
